cases.note: Typed grants bind capability, operation, resource, validity, budget, risk and conditions; non-matching or expired authority denies.
Risk categories and contextual risk elevation are evaluated fail-closed, while each decision retains policy version and typed input state.
Universal HTTP/MCP/worker/internal wiring, delegation attenuation, effect-time budget accounting, approval intent binding, and agent-facing runtime proof belong to later gates.

known_limitations: This artifact is a deterministic kernel/property fixture and not a QualificationBundle.
The fixture does not claim that the GOVERNANCE profile is qualified.
G2 universal authorization boundary and G3 delegation/hierarchical budget attenuation remain open.
Durable PostgreSQL persistence and runtime audit/event integration for grants and decisions remain open.
